title: (authz) Slot-claim replay protection in C slot coordinator
description: AUDIT (epic 6mij decomposition): coap_slot_coord.c has NO sequence/replay tracking: 'rg -n seq|replay|seen' over lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_slot_coord.c returns zero matches. A captured, validly-signed claim (Schnorr48 verify at coap_slot_coord.c:331 passes) can be REPLAYED to re-mutate allocation state; conflicting resolution is lowest-IID-wins (coap_slot_coord.c:11, spec/08-gateway-coordination.md:100-105), so a replay of an older low-IID claim can evict a newer legitimate owner. The Rust reference already advances replay high-water durably (see bd project-LICHEN-worker6-07cg: 'GatewayCoordinator::handle_post_slots durably advances SlotClaimVerifier replay state') - the C side has no equivalent. spec/06-security.md:16 mandates 'Replay: Sequence numbers, OSCORE replay window'. FIX (after the dispatch gate lands, worker6-2hte): either (a) rely on the OSCORE request-freshness window for protected claims and document that reliance here, or (b) add explicit per-peer claim seq monotonicity check in lichen_slot_coord_process_claim() mirroring the Rust SlotClaimVerifier; state which and test it. ACCEPTANCE: (1) replaying an accepted signed claim does not re-mutate state (test: POST same captured claim twice, second is rejected/ignored); (2) behavior matches the Rust reference path for the same claim sequence; (3) documented decision recorded in this issue.
